meta.title: Maya Razon
meta.description: Maya Razon — executive leadership development and learning experience design. Founding member of The Google School for Leaders.

hero.kicker: Executive leadership development · Learning experience design
hero.tagline: I design the programs — and the places — where leaders learn.
hero.sub: Twenty years in leadership development, the last ten as a founding member of The Google School for Leaders.

about.headingHtml: A leadership educator who takes the room as seriously as the curriculum.
about.p1: I helped found The Google School for Leaders, Google's global executive development function, where I've built programs, partnerships, and learning environments that have reached more than 10,000 leaders worldwide. I led the space and experience strategy for The Schoolhouse, Google's first purpose-built learning campus, and took Google's management development public for the first time through a course now available in Grow with Google.
about.p2: Before Google, I spent several years running my own consultancy, advising leaders at companies from Airbnb to Genentech — and before that, leading HR and Stores Learning & Development at Jamba Juice. I trained as a social worker and a cultural anthropologist, which still shapes how I think about people, culture, and change.
badges: BA Anthropology, UCLA — magna cum laude

cards.title: Executive development
cards.body: Designing and facilitating development experiences for the most senior leaders at Google and beyond — translating complex leadership frameworks into programs people actually use, from flagship curricula to bespoke interventions.

cards.title: Learning environments
cards.body: I led space and experience strategy for The Schoolhouse — Google's first purpose-built learning campus — applying neuroaesthetics research to how a learning space looks, feels, sounds, and even smells.
cards.note: Opened 2019 · 9,000 sq ft · four design awards

cards.title: Learning at scale
cards.body: Built People Development's first social-impact initiative, extending the School's expertise to social innovators worldwide — and launched Google's first external management development program, from concept to market.

roles.desc: Founding member of GSL, Google's reimagined global executive development function — building the strategy, programs, learning environments, and social-impact infrastructure behind an institution reaching 10,000+ leaders.
Led learning innovation strategy across People Development — turning research in neuroaesthetics, behavioral science, and environmental psychology into practical program and space design.
Designed and facilitated programs for Google's senior leaders, laying the groundwork for what became The Google School for Leaders.
Boutique organizational development consultancy. Advised C-suite and CHRO leaders on executive development, change, talent, and culture across 15+ Fortune 500 organizations.
Senior people leader across talent and organizational effectiveness; previously Director of Stores Learning & Development.
Senior Manager of Training for Gap Outlet; earlier, performance consultant and instructional designer.
